'''Calagott''' was a female [[Human/Legends|Human]] who sold [[Stimulant/Legends|stimulants]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Calagott appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]], as a Stims Vendor for Imperial players on Corellia.<ref name="TOR" />
